literal: From good conduct they will not swerve, the strong-minded, from slipping harm happening having known.
translation: Knowing the harm that comes from slipping into bad conduct, the strong-minded will not swerve from good conduct.
modern: தீய ஒழுக்கத்தால் துன்பம் வரும் என்பதை அறிந்து, மன உறுதி உடையவர்கள் நல்ல ஒழுக்கத்திலிருந்து விலக மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet emphasizes that people with true mental strength will never deviate from proper conduct. The word 'உரவோர்' refers to those who possess 'உரம்', meaning firmness or strength of mind. Such individuals will not shrink or swerve ('ஒல்கார்') from good behavior because they fully understand the consequences. They know the inevitable harm ('ஏதம்') that occurs ('படுபாக்கு') from 'இழுக்கம்', which means slipping or falling into bad conduct. Thus, unwavering moral discipline is presented as the hallmark of a strong mind.
